description: {"blocks":[{"key":"det77","text":"Catalase (CAT) activity measurement from copepod (Limnocalanus macrurus, Acartia sp., Eurytemora affinis, Temora longicornis, Calanus sp.), cladoceran (Eubosmina maritima) and pteropod (Limacina helicina) homogenates. This measurement for catalase (CAT) activity is a modified microplate version of the colorimetric catalase assay, where a reaction of catalase and H2O2 is stopped with NaN3 (Deissero \u0026 Dounce, 1970), an aliquot is pipetted to a microplate and the leftover H2O2 is detected with colorimetric reaction (Fossati et al., 1980).","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[{"style":"sub","offset":366,"length":1},{"style":"sub","offset":368,"length":1},{"style":"sub","offset":389,"length":1},{"style":"sub","offset":475,"length":1},{"style":"sub","offset":477,"length":1},{"style":"italic","offset":526,"length":7}],"entityRanges":[],"data":[]},{"key":"495lu","text":" ","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":[]},{"key":"4qiuu","text":"Deissero.A \u0026 Dounce, A. Physiological Reviews 50, 319-375.","type":"unstyled","depth":0,"inlineStyleRanges":[],"entityRanges":[],"data":[]},{"key":"10sds","text":"Fossati, P., Prencipe, L. \u0026 Berti, G. (1980).
